local.title: Set up a local Fresh Air Assistant
local.description: Give this installation a name, then select a weather provider and optionally a warning service. Rooms can be added afterwards.

data_description.display_mode: Both views use the same overall assessment. Ventilation need: 🟢 nothing to do · 🟡 keep watching · 🟠 ventilation is worthwhile · 🔴 ventilate now. Ventilation light: 🟢 good opportunity · 🟡 only partly suitable · 🟠/🔴 better keep closed. Hard protection instructions are always shown as 🔒.
data_description.outdoor_co2: Optional personal outdoor CO₂ sensor. When its reading is plausible, it represents the air directly at your location.

remote.title: Connect a remote Fresh Air Assistant
remote.description: Remote connections are deliberately limited to Tailscale addresses. Only the current state of the remote Fresh Air Assistant is transferred; its sensors and history are not created in this Home Assistant. “Continue” first tests the connection. It is saved only after the following success confirmation.

remote_confirm.description:
**✓ Connection successful**

**{remote_name}** is reachable through Tailscale.

**Found**
- Fresh Air Assistant instances: **{instances}**
- Rooms: **{rooms}**

{details}

Select “Submit” to save this connection.

Now choose the shared rooms that should be shown on this instance. New rooms will only become available for selection later and will not be added automatically.

The updated connection details work.

- Fresh Air Assistant instances: **{instances}**

user.title: Add room
user.description: Indoor temperature and humidity are required. CO₂, window/door contacts and a surface-temperature sensor are optional. The configured times only define when useful night advice may be shown. Missing optional sensor values are never estimated.

data.surface_temperature: Cold / critical surface temperature for moisture protection (optional)
data.remote_share: Allow this room to be queried remotely

data_description.target_temperature: Used when no suitable target temperature is available from a climate entity.
data_description.night_advice_start_time: From this time onward the advisor may show night advice. 22:00 only means “start checking then”, not “open the window then”.
data_description.night_advice_end_time: Night advice may remain visible until this time. Afterwards, the normal daytime assessment resumes without automatically triggering any action.
